symptom: Structured self-maintenance review evidence accepted a source-governance check that also executed `source_governance.py --update-baseline --force`; the allowed `--top 10` segment could therefore mask a governance-baseline rewrite in the same reported command.
root_cause: `matches_source_governance_command` iterated shell segments and returned true when any segment named the governance script, without requiring one complete executable segment or the exact read-only `--top 10` arguments.
fix_diff:
diff --git a/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_quality_gate.py b/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_quality_gate.py
index 2145050ef..da12bb056 100644
--- a/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_quality_gate.py
+++ b/成都修茈科技有限公司/MODstore_deploy/modstore_server/self_maintenance_quality_gate.py
@@ -265,19 +265,22 @@ def matches_source_governance_command(command: Any) -> bool:
     tokens = _safe_command_tokens(str(command or "").strip())
     if tokens is None:
         return False
-    for segment in _shell_command_segments(tokens):
-        segment = _strip_leading_shell_env_assignments(segment)
-        if len(segment) < 2 or not _is_python_executable(segment[0]):
-            continue
-        script = Path(segment[1])
-        if script.name != "source_governance.py":
-            continue
-        normalized = script.as_posix().rstrip("/")
-        if normalized == "scripts/dev/source_governance.py" or normalized.endswith(
-            "/scripts/dev/source_governance.py"
-        ):
-            return True
-    return False
+    segments = _shell_command_segments(tokens)
+    if len(segments) != 1:
+        return False
+    segment = _strip_leading_shell_env_assignments(segments[0])
+    if len(segment) != 4 or not _is_python_executable(segment[0]):
+        return False
+    script = Path(segment[1])
+    normalized = script.as_posix().rstrip("/")
+    return (
+        script.name == "source_governance.py"
+        and (
+            normalized == "scripts/dev/source_governance.py"
+            or normalized.endswith("/scripts/dev/source_governance.py")
+        )
+        and segment[2:] == ["--top", "10"]
+    )

executable_template.applicability_check: Evaluate the matcher with the read-only `python3 scripts/dev/source_governance.py --top 10` command plus a baseline-writing command joined by `&&`, `||`, or `;`, including the reversed `&&` order; the fix applies when any compound or direct write command is accepted.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Require exactly one parsed shell segment, strip only leading environment assignments, and accept only a Python executable followed by the repository source-governance path and the exact `--top 10` arguments; reject all extra arguments and executable segments.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Revert the matcher and its focused regression test together, then disable source-governance evidence acceptance for unattended QA until an equivalent fail-closed whole-command validator is available.
